about_the_game:
Demo Info:

This demo for Draggin' includes just enough to let you know what you're in for! Play through the first 10 levels of the game and enjoy the upgrades, costumes, and Draggins that you start out with in the full game.

If you want to complete challenges, unlock new upgrades and costumes, and more, check out the full game. Until then, enjoy the demo!

Look what the mouse dragged in!

Click and drag to cast area-of-effect spells to fend off waves of draggins, but be careful! While your magic field is a powerful weapon, it's also vulnerable to enemy attacks. Your key to success is dodging, weaving, and swooping in for devastating blows, all while strategizing your ideal build bit-by-bit.

  • Fight your way through new types of draggins in each locale.

  • Upgradeable spells and consumable potions to power you up as the challenge intensifies.

It just keeps draggin' on!

Discover new builds and strategies with each run while overcoming challenges to earn spells and cosmetics. Change the way you play as you strive for higher heights and get Margot some fresh fits!

  • 30+ challenges to hunt with each run for some sweet rewards.

  • Unlock new kinds of spells so spicing up your attacks can be even spicier.

  • Fill out Margot's wardrobe and customize your magic field.

What a drag!

Get lost-in-the-box as you're dragged into the experience of Draggin'! Enjoy the cutesy pixel aesthetics as you explore each environment, outfit your mouse in some rad regalia, power through challenges 'til you achieve it all, and jump in for just one more run!

name: Draggin' Demo
short_description: Fight draggins by draggin' the mouse in the demo for this cutesy arcade style bullet-hell! Click-and-drag to cast spells on your enemies and get your fill of wave battlin', achievement huntin', upgrade unlockin', rinse-and-repeatin'!
